sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
AND f.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Directly funded' AND f.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 560 AND sc.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(schools.School)
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 560 AND schools.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(sch.School)
FROM frpm AS frpm
JOIN satscores AS sat ON frpm.CDSCode = sat.cds
JOIN schools AS sch ON frpm.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.Charter = 1 AND frpm.CharterFundingType = 'Directly funded' AND sat.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.School)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(s.School)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE AVG(sat.AvgScrMath) > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(s.School)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
AND AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 560;

SELECT COUNT(s.School)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.AvgScrMath > 560 AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.NCESSchool)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 560;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.Charter School Number IN (
    SELECT Charter School Number
    FROM frpm
    GROUP BY Charter School Number
    HAVING AVG(AvgScrMath) > 560
)
AND f.FundingType = 'Directly funded';
